pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, polygonal regions with high edge-angularity and sharp pixel-intensity transitions. Interior patch area is spatially dominant over the interstitial corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow, light-hued pathways. Nodes consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections. Thickness is relatively uniform but decreases in the distal flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth contour along the dorsal neck ridge, created by short vertical hair extensions.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized textural disruption and light-colored de-pigmentation on the upper shoulder ridge, manifesting as a break in the dark patch continuity.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme tonal contrast between near-black patches and off-white interstitial pathways.
